hero.name: Rod Johnson
hero.title: Director of Architecture
hero.lede: I design how software gets built: the architecture, the standards and now the AI tools behind it.

about.heading: About
about.p1: I'm an architect and engineering leader with 21 years of taking systems from the first whiteboard sketch to production. Most recently I helped AMH rethink how its developers work, bringing in AI tools like Claude and MCP servers, automated DevOps and earlier security checks. I built the tooling and trained developers across the company to use it.
about.p2: I'm good at getting different teams pulling in the same direction, setting standards that stick, and shaping how teams hire and test. I've worked in banking, real estate, marketing, logistics, procurement, government, healthcare and e-learning. I'm based in Salt Lake City and work in English and Spanish.

items.title: Company-wide AI architecture, AMH
items.body: AI-assisted software delivery built on Claude, MCP servers and automated DevOps, with security checks earlier in the process.

items.title: Grants and contracts platform, State of Indiana
items.body: Led it from start to finish.

items.title: Logging library, Microsoft Site Reliability Engineering
items.body: Became the department's standard. My reference microservice became the model for later services.

items.title: Shared .NET codebase, Solution Stream
items.body: Every project started from it. I also designed the technical interview process.

building.heading: What I'm building
building.lede: On my own time I build with AI agents, end to end.

items.title: Should
items.body: A personal system of AI agents that runs the busywork of my life, so my mind is free for living and deciding.

items.title: AgencyPro
items.body: Your AI does the work, and real people fill the gaps. A product of Pro Squared Holdings, my company.

items.title: Agentic Squared
items.body: Credentialed people for the steps AI can't sign, routed through AgencyPro.

items.title: Privacy Squared
items.body: Finds your listings on people-search and data-broker sites, files the opt-outs, and keeps checking. Another Pro Squared Holdings product.

how.heading: How I work
how.quote: Be regular and orderly in your life, so that you may be violent and original in your work.

items.title: Whiteboard to production
items.body: I stay with a design until it ships.

items.title: Standards that stick
items.body: A few clear rules teams actually follow beat a thick binder.

items.title: AI as a teammate
items.body: Agents with tight permissions, human review on anything that matters, and security checks early.

how.stack: Stack: .NET and C#, TypeScript, Python, Azure, Docker, CI/CD, microservices, Claude and MCP.
